pipeline.fact: Agent.default.stt_node wraps nonstreaming LocalSTT in StreamAdapter, which creates its own VAD stream. AudioRecognition also creates a separate VAD stream for user-state events. A session speaking/listening pair does not prove adapter EOS or recognize submission. Silero stream() creates per-stream model state.

AgentActivity.push_audio sends silence to STT during active AEC warmup or uninterruptible speech; VAD receives original frames through AudioRecognition._push_audio. First speaking starts a one-shot warmup timer. Default3.0s applies because PRISM supplies no aec_warmup_duration; current speech allows interruptions by default, making AEC the relevant silence branch.

StreamAdapter awaits recognition serially after its own END_OF_SPEECH. LocalSTT appends its resampled segment before awaiting one shared single-worker engine pool; native calls and retranscriptions can queue. Current stt duration starts after preparation but before queue submission, mixing queue wait, WAV work, native work and event-loop resume. Only a successful return logs completion.

StreamAdapter drops empty alternatives/text. LocalSTT normally logs an empty successful result before it is dropped; absence of that completion log weakens this explanation. Cancellation before await resumes also omits completion logging and cannot stop an already-running native pool job. SDK recognize() has no generic timeout wrapper around _recognize_impl; this implementation does not use conn_options to bound native execution.

The application forwards only interim user_input_transcribed events directly and invokes Coordinator.on_user_turn from on_user_turn_completed. A final STT event and a finalized coordinator user_final are separate boundaries. Adaptive transcript holding and manual-turn rejection exist in SDK but current explicit VAD mode supplies neither as the leading explanation; no completed local STT log exists for this clip.

interruption_word_dependency.fact: Do not describe all interruption as word-gated: SDK audio-activity pause can happen without words at min_words0, subject to the0.5s VAD threshold and AEC gate. AEC explicitly suppresses this path during warmup. Final transcript/committed turn can permanently interrupt a paused handle; PRISM itself only clears the floor on VAD, then increments intent and cancels active speech on a finalized nonempty turn. Nonstreaming LocalSTT provides no interim words.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: AEC silence substitution prevented adapter speech detection / recognition dispatch
hypotheses_ranked.support: Strong source-and-timing inference: entire correction and its VAD listening event precede predicted warmup expiry, first ack never triggered speaking, no localSTT completion follows. Component routing reproduced.
hypotheses_ranked.missing: Actual active gate and STT branch PCM in original run.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Adapter-specific VAD did not close a speech segment or STT input/consumer stalled
hypotheses_ranked.support: Mechanically possible because detector streams/channels are independent.
hypotheses_ranked.missing: Adapter VAD EOS and per-branch frame receipts; not directly evidenced.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Recognition submitted but remained queued/native-running or cancelled before coroutine resumed
hypotheses_ranked.support: Mechanically possible with shared single-worker executor and serial adapter; existing completion-only timing cannot identify these boundaries.
hypotheses_ranked.missing: Submit, worker entry, native start/end, cancellation and await-resume timestamps; no claim of a hang or memory cause.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Recognition returned empty / a final was filtered before turn completion
hypotheses_ranked.support: SDK can omit empty finals and application user_final is downstream of STT.
hypotheses_ranked.missing: Would normally have a LocalSTT completion log; none appears. Current VAD configuration does not support asserting adaptive/manual filtering.

minimal_opt_in_observability: Assign room, segment ID and operation kind (segment/retranscribe/warmup) before recognition. Buffer monotonic_ns+wall-anchor stage receipts in memory: recognize_enter, executor_submit, worker_enter, WAV_ready, native_enter, native_return, worker_exit, await_resume, event_return; explicit cancelled/error with same ID. Store sample rate/count and PCM hash on the worker, not in the event-loop callback. Native completion may outlive cancelled await; record both independently.

Use the public Agent.stt_node override to wrap the audio iterator passed unchanged to Agent.default.stt_node, aggregating delivered frame/sample/nonzero counts and preserving opt-in post-gate PCM only for this development experiment. Correlate with existing session VAD events and recorder input. No added VAD pass or altered segmentation; seeing zero STT frames during real VAD activity distinguishes withholding from a model queue.

At session start record effective aec_warmup_duration and interruption options. For exact gate attribution, add bounded diagnostic snapshots of the installed SDK AEC timer/remaining state and current handle interruptibility at user-state transitions, explicitly version-scoped private reads; no monkeypatch or algorithm change. If private reads are avoided, retain gate attribution as inference from post-gate PCM and default timing.

Record all user_input_transcribed events (final and interim), LocalSTT metrics/error, and on_user_turn_completed as separate lightweight receipts. Optional transcription_timeout is a supported diagnostic event, disabled by default; listen without generating a reply or changing turn decisions.

Persist diagnostics through an owned off-loop writer with explicit dropped-record/flush/cleanup status; no per-frame sync disk writes. Capture all declared cases including missing segments and empty/error/cancelled outcomes. Do not silently retry or extend a deadline.

supported_setting.name: AgentSession(aec_warmup_duration=...)
supported_setting.location: agent/main.py entrypoint AgentSession constructor (preserved iteration10 lines112–116); not a turn_handling/interruption option.
supported_setting.implementation_semantics: Explicit duration bypasses participant-type auto-selection. None or0 sets remaining0, disables startup silence substitution and its AEC interruption guard. It does not disable actual client/device acoustic echo cancellation.
supported_setting.appropriate_scope: A separately declared local prerecorded no-echo PCM condition may explicitly disable the suppression to measure this boundary. For physical microphones/speakers, removing echo warmup can admit echo-driven recognition/interruptions; retain current default absent a separate measured real-mic decision. No production setting changed.

component_reproduction.method: Call actual installed AgentActivity.push_audio and AudioRecognition._push_audio with dummy output channels and deterministic nonzero20ms16k PCM; use the real3s loop timer and actual AgentSession._on_aec_warmup_expired callback. No model modules, RTC service or VAD inference. Timer setup is explicit in harness; first-speaking timer creation is separately inspected in source.
component_reproduction.boundary: Proves installed component routing for given state, not that the original runtime took that path or that an actual recognizer would recover a transcript.

limits: No live rerun, model inference, algorithm change or global setting change.
